sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our personal dedication and decades of casting expertise go into every single piece we deliver from our family foundry to your facilities.

For our current offer, we can propose a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. However, as a family-run foundry, we must insist on maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms to support our operations. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and valid from 1 February 2027: €52.00 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
As we have already factored the notice period into our previous offer, we cannot make further concessions without a constructive step from your side.
We therefore maintain our offer of €52.30 for the 60-day payment term and 24-month contract.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. In our family foundry, we take every detail seriously, and we received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. 

As the notice period data has already been fully accounted for, we cannot make further concessions without a constructive step from your side. We therefore maintain our offer of €52.30 for the 60-day payment term and 24-month contract.

To state the full terms clearly, our offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value the long relationship between our companies deeply, and we trust we can find a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
